titleEn: Early changes linked to ovarian cancer may leave a trace in the blood – new study
titleZh: 卵巢癌的早期变化，可能在血液中留下痕迹
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: The most common type of ovarian cancer tends to grow quickly. It’s called high-grade serous ovarian cancer and often starts in a fallopian tube, one of the tubes that carry eggs from the ovaries towards the womb.
paragraphs.zh: 最常见的一种卵巢癌往往生长迅速，被称为高级别浆液性卵巢癌，通常始于输卵管，输卵管是将卵子从卵巢输送到子宫的管道之一。

paragraphs.en: The first changes can be so small that they’re usually found only when a specialist examines the tube under a microscope after surgery. Now, a new study suggests that some of those changes may leave a trace in the blood.
paragraphs.zh: 最初的变化可能很小，通常只有在手术后由专家在显微镜下检查试管时才能发现。现在，一项新的研究表明，其中一些变化可能会在血液中留下痕迹。

paragraphs.en: The researchers looked for a molecule called Tu-stroma in stored blood samples. They found higher levels in people with early cancer that had begun growing into nearby tissue. Levels were also higher in people with a tiny patch of abnormal cells still confined to the lining of the fallopian tube. This patch, known as serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma (Stic for short), can be an early step towards this type of ovarian cancer. The next step is to follow people over time to find out when the signal first appears.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员在储存的血液样本中寻找一种名为Tu基质的分子。他们发现，在已经开始向附近组织生长的早期癌症患者体内，Tu基质的水平更高。在输卵管内壁仍有一小片异常细胞的患者体内，Tu基质的水平也更高。这小片异常细胞被称为浆液性输卵管上皮内癌（简称Stic），可以是向这种类型的卵巢癌迈出的早期一步。下一步是随着时间的推移跟踪人们，找出信号第一次出现的时间。

paragraphs.en: Ovarian cancer can cause symptoms such as persistent bloating and pain in the tummy or low down between the hips. Some people feel full after eating very little or need to pee more often. These symptoms are common in other conditions too. If they persist or keep coming back, it’s worth getting them checked by a GP.
paragraphs.zh: 卵巢癌会引起持续性腹胀、腹痛或臀部疼痛等症状。有些人吃得很少就会感到饱，或者需要更频繁地小便。这些症状在其他情况下也很常见。如果症状持续存在或反复出现，就值得去看医生。

paragraphs.en: When investigating symptoms, doctors may use a blood test for CA125, a protein whose level can rise when ovarian cancer is present. Other conditions can raise it too, including endometriosis, in which tissue similar to the womb lining grows elsewhere in the body. Some people with early ovarian cancer still have a low CA125 level. The UK has no routine screening programme to check people without symptoms for ovarian cancer.
paragraphs.zh: 在研究症状时，医生可能会对血液进行CA 125检测，这是一种在卵巢癌发生时会升高的蛋白质。其他疾病也会升高CA 125，包括子宫内膜异位症。其中类似子宫内膜的组织生长在身体的其他部位。一些早期卵巢癌患者的CA 125水平仍然很低。英国没有常规的筛查项目来检查没有卵巢癌症状的人。癌

paragraphs.en: Tu-stroma is a type of RNA, one of the molecules cells use to control how they work. Earlier research showed that ovarian cancer cells can release Tu-stroma in tiny packages called extracellular vesicles. Think of these as microscopic parcels carrying messages from one cell to another. The researchers measured how much Tu-stroma these parcels were carrying in the blood.
paragraphs.zh: Tu-stroma是一种RNA，是细胞用来控制其工作方式的分子之一。早期的研究表明，卵巢癌细胞可以在称为细胞外囊泡的微小包裹中释放Tu-stroma。可以把这些看作是从一个细胞向另一个细胞传递信息的微观包裹。研究人员测量了这些包裹在血液中携带的Tu-stroma的量。

paragraphs.en: They analysed samples from 506 people, including 43 with Stic alone. In a separate group used to check how well the test worked, it picked up Stic in about 92% of those who had it. The test showed no signs of Stic in about 98% of people in the healthy comparison group. In these samples, Tu-stroma did a better job than CA125 of telling people with Stic apart from people who were healthy or had non-cancerous growths around the ovaries or fallopian tubes.
paragraphs.zh: 他们分析了来自506人的样本，其中43人只接受了Stic测试。在另一个用来检查测试效果的小组中，测试在92%的测试者中检测到了Stic。测试显示，在健康对照组中，大约98%的人没有Stic的迹象。在这些样本中，Tu-stroma比CA 125能更好地区分患有Stic的人与健康的人或卵巢或输卵管周围有非癌性生长的人。

paragraphs.en: There’s an important catch. The researchers were working with samples from people whose diagnoses were already known. Only a small number had Stic, so the results are still uncertain. If the test were offered widely to people without symptoms, very few would be likely to have these patches of abnormal cells. Even a small proportion of false alarms could send many people for unnecessary tests or even surgery.
paragraphs.zh: 这里有一个重要的问题。研究人员正在研究的样本来自那些已经被确诊的人。只有一小部分人患有静止性甲状腺肿，因此结果仍然不确定。如果这项测试被广泛提供给没有症状的人，很少有人可能会有这些异常细胞。即使是一小部分的误报，也可能会让许多人接受不必要的测试，甚至手术。

paragraphs.en: What it could mean for people at higher risk
paragraphs.zh: 这对高危人群意味着什么

paragraphs.en: BRCA1 and BRCA2 are genes that help repair damage to DNA, the genetic instructions in our cells. People who inherit a harmful change in either gene have a higher risk of ovarian cancer. They may be advised to consider surgery to remove their ovaries and fallopian tubes once they have finished having children or if they do not plan to have them. The operation lowers their risk, but it ends their ability to get pregnant without fertility treatment. If they haven’t yet reached menopause, the sudden drop in hormones after surgery brings it on straight away.
paragraphs.zh: BRCA 1和BRCA 2是帮助修复DNA损伤的基因，DNA是我们细胞中的遗传指令。遗传了其中一个基因的有害变化的人患卵巢癌的风险较高。一旦他们生完孩子或者不打算生孩子，他们可能会被建议考虑手术切除卵巢和输卵管。手术降低了他们的风险。但如果她们还没有到更年期，手术后荷尔蒙的突然下降会使她们马上进入更年期。

paragraphs.en: The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (Nice) advises that specialist teams can consider regular CA125 testing for some people at high inherited risk who delay or decline surgery. Tu-stroma might one day improve that monitoring. For now, even if the experimental test picks up no warning signs, that result gives someone no basis to postpone recommended surgery.
paragraphs.zh: 尼斯国家健康与护理卓越研究所（National Institute for Health and Care Excellence，Nice）建议，专家团队可以考虑对一些推迟或拒绝手术的高遗传风险人群进行定期CA 125检测。Tu-stroma或许有一天会改善这种监测。就目前而言，即使实验性检测没有发现任何警告信号，但这一结果也无法为推迟推荐的手术提供依据。

paragraphs.en: A large UK trial found that screening with CA125 picked up more ovarian and fallopian tube cancers at an early stage. Even after years of follow-up, there was no clear evidence that fewer people died from those cancers. With Tu-stroma, researchers still need to find out how often the abnormal cells in the tube lining start growing into nearby tissue. They also need to work out what to do if the blood test flags a problem but a scan shows nothing. The question a screening trial would ultimately have to answer is whether acting on that result saves lives.
paragraphs.zh: 英国一项大型试验发现，CA 125筛查在早期发现了更多的卵巢癌和输卵管癌。即使经过多年的随访，也没有明确的证据表明死于这些癌症的人数减少。研究人员还需要弄清楚输卵管内壁中的异常细胞多长时间开始长入附近的组织。2他们还需要弄清楚如果血液检测结果不对该怎么办筛查试验最终要回答的问题是，根据这个结果采取行动是否能挽救生命。
